open_points.subject: Authority when resuming a resend after an unknown outcome was resolved not_applied
open_points.text: flow:wait_resume_resolve_cancel step 2 says “otherwise the unused approval first, then a grant still active”, while flow:run_effect_with_approval step 2 says a grant cannot authorize “a resend after not_applied” and step 6 says a draft-write grant is never used.
open_points.question: If the fresh approval used for a resend after not_applied remains unused because that resend was not sent, but its request no longer matches when resumed, must the element request another fresh approval, or may an active grant authorize it?
options: Require a matching fresh approval and never fall back to a grant for any resend after not_applied.
Allow an active grant when the previous fresh approval no longer matches on resume.
open_points.default_guess: Require a matching fresh approval; if the request changed, request another approval and do not use the grant.
